description.value: At 1st level, as a move action, a necromancer can infuse an undead creature within 30 feet with shadow energy. It gains a +1 profane bonus on all attack rolls and saving throws, as well as 2 temporary hit points per necromancer level and a +2 bonus to its turn resistance. The bonus on attack rolls and saving throws increases by +1 for every five necromancer levels he possesses. These bonuses last for a number of minutes equal to his necromancer level. He can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + his Charisma modifier.
